title: Coach Says Smile First
style: country pop jazz big band phonk backbeat, female lead vocal, brass hits, stomp kick, warm coaching energy, 100 BPM, pickleball mental reset anthem, big chorus, spoken bridge
lyrics:
[Intro — stomp kick, brass hit, country twang phonk]
(spoken, warm coach voice)
Before the serve. Before the swing.
Smile first.

[Verse 1]
You double-faulted on the last one
Your partner's quiet, crowd moved on
Your paddle's heavy, legs are tense
That's when the coach leans in and says:
Loosen your grip — three out of ten
Roll your shoulders, breathe again
The ball doesn't know what just happened
The court doesn't hold your score
The only thing that matters now
Is who you are before

[Pre-Chorus — horns rise]
You are not the last mistake
You are not the point you gave away
Body language sets the brain
Coach says smile — and the body obeys

[Chorus — full band stomp backbeat]
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST
BEFORE THE SERVE, BEFORE THE SWING
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST
RESET EVERYTHING
Shoulders back, chin up, breathe
The best point you'll ever play
Hasn't happened yet
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST

[Verse 2 — training specific]
Between every point — reset position
Walk to the baseline with intention
Bounce the ball three times before you serve
That rhythm is yours — it's what you deserve
Eye on the ball, not on their face
You don't play them — you play the space
Five seconds between each point — it's the rule
Five seconds to find your cool

[Chorus — reprise]
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST
BEFORE THE SERVE, BEFORE THE SWING
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST
RESET EVERYTHING

[Bridge — half-time phonk, spoken over groove]
When you're down 4-9 in the third
Smile.
When the Erne just caught you off guard
Smile.
When your partner shanked the ATP
Smile — and call it a learning.
When you're up 10-9 and the serve matters
Smile — and trust your body.
You've done the reps. You've done the drills.
The smile is not fake.
The smile tells your nervous system:
I've got this.
Now play.

[Final Chorus — biggest]
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST
BEFORE THE SERVE, BEFORE THE SWING
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST
RESET EVERYTHING
Shoulders back, chin up, breathe
The best point you'll ever play
Hasn't happened yet
COACH SAYS SMILE FIRST

[Outro — brass fade, warm]
Smile first.
Every time.
That's the first shot.
